finding: The M671 boundary structurally checks plan, manifest, permit, claim, and GM identifiers, but its synchronous validator does not recompute authorization/manifest/permit digests or compare claimState.permitSha256 to permit.permitSha256. A future executor must perform those asynchronous verifications before treating the claim as dispatch-ready.
selectedNext: M673 code-only: add an asynchronous fail-closed boundary validator that verifies all canonical hashes and exact claim/permit identity before any executor implementation.
